_comment: Vocabulary the gate scans for on its own, independent of how the AI classified each decision. The two are UNIONed - the agent cannot clear its own stop by calling something 일반.
_why_two_tiers: The first tuned run raised 16 of 19 decisions because 매출 was a flat keyword and this is a revenue dashboard - every decision mentions it. A gate that fires on almost everything gets rubber-stamped, which is the same as no gate. So a bare domain noun is no longer a signal on its own: `strong` terms name an irreversible act and raise alone, `weak` terms are domain nouns that only raise when a rule-setting word sits nearby. Precision here buys attention for the few that matter.
_matching: Case-insensitive substring over the decision text, rationale, title and section heading. A weak term needs a rule_word within the same decision.
_why_role_scope: A third axis, because tuning out the domain-noun false positives also silenced ' 지점 관리자도 전체 매출 랭킹을 조회할 수 있다' - the exact shape this gate exists for. A role noun next to a scope word is the permission signal; neither is one on its own.
